about: Decision 076 S0: which printed block opens a section of a play, for a reader's contents. Every stack's sectionLevel/section_level returns `level` for `text`; js/plays-core.js and catalog/tools/script_parse.py both run these cases. `title` is the reader's heading (the first printed line, italic marks and runs of spaces dropped); `act` is the act's number as printed, upper-cased, so ACT I. SCENE II. after ACT I. is a scene of the same act.
